joi_block.name: Scenario

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 1초마다 거실 조도가 200lux 이하이면 스탠드 플러그를 켜고, 그렇지 않고 500lux 이상이면 꺼줘.
command_eng: Every 1 second, if the living room illuminance is at most 200 lux, turn on the floor lamp plug; otherwise if it is at least 500 lux, turn off the floor lamp plug.
